Fire. It's the only way to be sure.

If you want to COMPLETELY remove them, the only option is to burn the house down, I'm afraid.

If you just want to reduce their numbers, call an exterminator. Some will escape and some will be replaced a few weeks later, but as long as you keep the place clean so that you don't attract a lot of other bugs there won't be enough food to sustain a large population of spiders. Spiders eat other bugs, if the amount of other bugs are kept to a minimum, so will the number of spiders.

Clean top to bottom. Like vacuume and scrub the shit out of your place. Wash all of your clothes and bedding, bag it. Pick up everything and then bug bomb with something good for spiders if you can't afford pro pest control. Finally, clean thoroughly on a regular basis afterward. Spiders are a bitch to get rid of. Make sure you keep up with your lawn too because that can attract them in.
